locations.label: Summoning Key / spawn setup
locations.description: Use a flaming chalice to enter Beast mode. Shock fuse boxes to power perks and stairs, melee chained crates and doors, and grapple to the glowing hooks above you. Plan each route before transforming: you return to the same chalice when time runs out. A used chalice stays unavailable for that round. Spawn: break the truck crate for the Summoning Key; shock the Junction crane, then grapple above Easy Street and shock the exterior box behind Nero’s loft to open its stairs. Canals: shock the box behind the translucent wall at the far end of the canal; break the badge box beside the rift. Grapple to Ruby Rabbit and run down to shock its entrance stairs. Waterfront: grapple above the district Mystery Box and knock down the belt crate. Break the Boxing Gym’s front door. Footlight: grapple to the upper walkway; jump from the small ramp to the crate ledge and knock the crate down. Grapple to Black Lace Burlesque and shock the box behind its sign. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Underground Pack-a-Punch ritual
locations.description: Build the Rocket Shield before longer defenses. Open the upper perk routes and collect one piece per district, checking the three nearby alternatives listed below. Build at Waterfront behind the gym, Canals outside Ruby Rabbit, or Footlight below the train station. Get Juggernog and a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon; the Servant is excellent crowd control but is not a substitute for accurate Shadowman damage. Footlight window: bench opposite the perk, fence beside it, or chair in the stairs room toward Burlesque. Canals base: lion-head room wall, connecting bridge, or window opposite the perk. Waterfront rockets: by the upper stairs/chalice, window near the perk, or floor farther into the burning room. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Ruby Rabbit ritual
locations.description: Return as a human to collect the Summoning Key and dropped items. Take each item to its matching ritual table, then interact again to start. Gather the team inside first: the door locks during the ritual. Keep moving until it finishes and collect the Gateworm. A Margwa appears after the second and fourth rituals; shoot its open yellow mouths one at a time. Lawyer’s Pen, Junction crane → Nero’s loft above spawn. Detective’s Badge, Canals → upper floor of Ruby Rabbit. Championship Belt, Waterfront → center of the Boxing Gym ring. Producer’s Toupee, Footlight → Black Lace Burlesque stage. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
